selection_reason: Smallest largest connected unresolved gap among the five tested profiles; not the smallest total missing area. No profile passes the unchanged coverage criteria.
reproduction: Build cad/build_full_line_test.py. For each non-selected trial copy the generated output directory to a separate directory, write process_overrides to JSON and pass --output and --process to scripts/slice_line_gradient_test.py, then validate that output. Complete effective process profiles are included below.

process.name: myAI variable Farbbahnen ab 0.32 mm P1S
process.print_settings_id: myAI variable Farbbahnen ab 0.32 mm P1S
process.description: It has a general layer height, and results in general layer lines and printing quality. It is suitable for most general printing cases.

geometry.method: Extrusion of the approved full-gradient SVG; no endpoint reassignment or added border.

coverage.method: CAD layer cross-sections minus union of nominal G-code width capsules with round end caps; arcs flattened to <=0.001 mm chord error
coverage.limitations: Nominal planar footprint, not measured filament flow, surface sheen, bonding or optical opacity. Does not model the order/overlap of neighboring colors. Tiny CAD corner differences and molten material behavior remain uncertain.
